def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_asset_value = 515.0
    ending_asset_value = 602.5
    management_fee_rate = 0.02
    incentive_fee_rate = 0.20
    hurdle_rate = 0.05
    high_water_mark = 540.0

    # Calculate the management fee based on end-of-year assets
    management_fee = ending_asset_value * management_fee_rate

    # Calculate the hurdle value based on the high-water mark
    hurdle_value = high_water_mark * (1 + hurdle_rate)

    # Calculate the incentive fee on gains above the hurdle
    incentive_profit = max(0.0, ending_asset_value - hurdle_value)
    incentive_fee = incentive_profit * incentive_fee_rate

    # Calculate the investor's ending value and net return
    investor_ending_value = ending_asset_value - management_fee - incentive_fee
    net_return = (investor_ending_value - initial_asset_value) / initial_asset_value

    # Return the net return rounded to three decimal places
    return round(net_return, 3)
